saw_lines: Pet owners rarely browse for medication. They reorder the same product from memory, and trust the first clear reason to switch.
So the sale is won or lost in the opening line, where a buyer decides if this store is worth a click.
Your 3 of 5 copy ads share one exact script. Keep that copy, but change the opening line and creative in each so buyers stop seeing the same pitch.
ads_1: Two new openers tested against the pet care story, each with a proof number
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
